## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: weak overall breadth (4/11) and concentrated leadership (Top 5 are all Technology), with a major divergence in large caps — suppresses a clear risk-on/down call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +26.23% | 1M: +39.74%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +13.18%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials: RCL (1W: +12.87% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +2.41% | 1M: -2.07%) RECOVERY. Consumer Discretionary: F (1W: +11.39% | 1M: +39.40%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -9.65% | 1M: -14.98%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND, COST (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak: VTR (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -7.00%) BELOW TREND, WELL (1W: -8.70% | 1M: -8.88%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +26.23% | 1M: +39.74%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +17.37% | 1M: +15.48%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +16.40% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 = 5/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MO (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND, VTR (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -7.00%) BELOW TREND, BMY (1W: -7.58% | 1M: -9.31%) BELOW TREND, COST (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -8.64% | 1M: +4.60%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in defensive and property names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NOW (1W: +33.03%), IBM (1W: +26.23%), SHOP (1W: +20.50%), PLTR (1W: +17.37%), PANW (1W: +15.31%) — all ABOVE TREND. Watch major divergence in big caps: AAPL (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +12.99%) CORRECTION and INTC (1W: -8.77% | 1M: +15.72%) CORRECTION — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE and warrants caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but leading on headline movers; NVDA (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +13.18%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: -8.77% | 1M: +15.72%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Technology is one of the 4/11 positive sectors; leadership is narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials sliding at the index level; JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth negative and not confirming a cyclical rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing dispersion: LLY (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +15.99%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -2.20%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION. News catalysts (ABT +70, MRK +60) could drive pockets of strength, but sector is overall weak.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective tech leaders and high-conviction names showing multi-timeframe confirmation (NOW, IBM, MSFT, NVDA, LLY). Reduce exposure to defensives/real estate/utility laggards and monitor major cap divergences; Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but leadership is narrow, so be selective.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +26.23% | 1M: +39.74%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.31% | 1M: +67.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.77% | 1M: +15.72%) CORRECTION, CEG (1W: -9.65% | 1M: -14.98%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Industrials (both positive on 1W performance; breadth still narrow). BEARISH: Utilities, Consumer Staples, Real Estate — all showing sector weakness and downside leadership.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch trend-confirmation triggers rather than exact prices: NVDA sustaining 1M positive momentum (stay ABOVE TREND) to validate continuation; AAPL remaining in CORRECTION (1W negative while 1M positive) — watch for 1W reversal; JPM needs 1M stabilization to exit BELOW TREND status; INTC further 1W weakness would risk flipping to sustained BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+65): Nvidia chip news — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +12.42%) — sentiment confirming price strength. PLTR (+55): Palantir headline — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.37% | 1M: +15.48%) — sentiment confirming. PANW (+50): NATO win — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.31% | 1M: +67.57%) — confirming. PFE (+55): Oncology deal — price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -2.42%) — bullish news but price diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
GOOGL (-65): $80B equity raise fears — price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -2.19%) — sentiment confirming downside. ADBE (-55): CEO exit headlines — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.35%) — negative sentiment diverging from price (watch for follow-through). UNH (-55): lawsuit headlines — UNH CORRECTION (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +2.53%) — bearish news aligns with short-term weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt but leadership is narrow. NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +26.23% | 1M: +39.74%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +13.18%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is the major divergence among large caps (AAPL CORRECTION, INTC CORRECTION, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and mixed news sentiment (ADBE negative vs price up) — watch for trend breaks.
